Dim Tbmrsys, ret, ni, nj, satirNo, Fields, satirSayisi, AlanAdi, AlanDegeri, hmdSatir
ret=Doc.Calc_Bom("O","M", RAPOR.KOD,1,RAPOR.SF_MIKTAR,"",RAPOR.FOKOD,"","","","","","")   
Set Tbmrsys =Doc.GetTableObject("_WBMRSYS_SELECT")
Fields = RaporRowSet.GetFields()
hmdSatir = 0
If isarray(Fields) Then
	For ni = 1 to Tbmrsys.GetRowCount()
		if Tbmrsys.BOMREC_INPUTTYPE(ni) = "H" Then
			hmdSatir = hmdSatir + 1
			RaporRowSet.AddRow
			satirNo = RaporRowSet.GetRowCount()
			For nj = 0 to uBound(Fields, 1)
				AlanAdi = Fields(nj,0)
				if AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_KODU" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni)
				Elseif AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_ADI" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni), "")
				Elseif AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_MIKTAR" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(ni)
				Elseif AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_BIRIM" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "IUNIT", Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni), "")
				Else
					if AlanAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" and hmdsatir > 1 Then
						AlanDegeri = 0
					Else
						AlanDegeri = RaporRowSet.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, row)
					End if
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, AlanDegeri
				End if
			Next
		End if
	Next
	if hmdSatir > 0 Then RAPOR.DEL = "X"
End if Dim KarsiHesap
if trim(RAPOR.EVRAKTYPE) = "SF" Then
	if Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK74E", "IADEMI", RAPOR.EVRAKNO, "") <> "1" Then
		RAPOR.ADET = 1
	End if
Elseif trim(RAPOR.EVRAKTYPE) = "CF" Then
	KarsiHesap = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI20T", "MUHASEBECODE", RAPOR.EVRAKTYPE+RAPOR.EVRAKNO+RAPOR.TRNUM, "EVRAKTYPE+EVRAKNO+TRNUM")
	if Left(KarsiHesap,1) = "7" or Left(KarsiHesap,2) = "15" or Left(KarsiHesap,2) = "25" Then
		RAPOR.ADET = 1
	Else
		RAPOR.IPTAL = "E"
	End if
	if RAPOR.BORCFIYAT > 0 Then
		RAPOR.IPTAL = "E"
	End if
Else
	RAPOR.IPTAL = "E"
	RAPOR.ADET = 0
End if 	Dim aFiy, Fiyat, Tutar, PB, Kur
	aFiy = Doc.GetStdFiyat("S","DF", "","FT_DFII", Doc.BuGun,0,RAPOR.MUSTERIKODU,RAPOR.KOD,RAPOR.SF_SF_UNIT,RAPOR.FOKOD, _

	RAPOR.TL_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR = Fiyat * RAPOR.SF_MIKTAR * Kur

QStr = "KOD='"+RAPOR.KOD+"'&KULLANIM_YERI='1'"
Set S48T = Doc.Select1("ASASASA", "STOK48T", QStr, "<KRI_TARIH_1", -1)

	Fiyat = S48T.PRICE(1)
	PB = S48T.PRICEUNIT(1)
End if
if Fiyat = 0 Then
	QStr = "KOD='"+RAPOR.KOD+"'&IADEMI<>'1'"

		PB = S48T.PRICEUNIT(1)
	End if
End if
if Fiyat > 0 Then
	Kur = Doc.GetKurN(PB, "", Tarih, "", -1)
	RAPOR.TL_FIYAT = Fiyat * Kur
Else
	if RAPOR.KART_TIPI = "F" Then
		QStr = "KOD='"+RAPOR.KOD+"'"
		Set S48T = Doc.Select1("ASAAA", "STOK74T", QStr, "<TARIH", -1)

			Fiyat = S48T.OR_FIYAT(1)
			PB = S48T.PRICEUNIT(1)
		End if
		Kur = Doc.GetKurN(PB, "", Tarih, "", -1)
		FasonTLFiyat = Fiyat * Kur

		ret=Doc.Calc_Bom("O","M",RAPOR.KOD,1,1,"","","","","","","","")  	 	
		Set Tbmrsys = Doc.GetTableObject("_WBMRSYS_SELECT") 		
		TLFiyat = 0
		For ni = 1 to Tbmrsys.GetRowCount()
			QStr = "KOD='"+Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni)+"'"
			Set S48T = Doc.Select1("ASAAA", "STOK74T", QStr, "<TARIH", -1)
			if S48T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
				Fiyat = S48T.OR_FIYAT(1)
				PB = S48T.PRICEUNIT(1)
				Kur = Doc.GetKurN(PB, "", Tarih, "", -1)
				TLFiyat = TLFiyat + Fiyat * Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(ni) * Kur
			End if
		Next
		RAPOR.TL_FIYAT = TLFiyat + FasonTLFiyat                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             Else
		nrows = Doc.SelectEQ("BOMU01E", "MAMULCODE", RAPOR.KOD)
		if nrows = 0 Then

			Set S48T = Doc.Select1("ASAAA", "STOK74T", QStr, "<TARIH", -1)

				PB = S48T.PRICEUNIT(1)
			End if

			Kur = Doc.GetKurN(PB, "", Tarih, "", -1)
			RAPOR.TL_FIYAT = Fiyat * Kur
		Else
			ret=Doc.Calc_Bom("O","M",RAPOR.KOD,1,1,"","","","","","","","")

Dim Tbmrsys, ret, ni, nj, satirNo, Fields, satirSayisi, AlanAdi, AlanDegeri, hmdSatir
ret=Doc.Calc_Bom("O","M", RAPOR.STOKCODE,1,1,"",RAPOR.FOKOD,"","","","","","")   
Set Tbmrsys =Doc.GetTableObject("_WBMRSYS_SELECT")
Fields = RaporRowSet.GetFields()
hmdSatir = 0
If isarray(Fields) Then
	For ni = 1 to Tbmrsys.GetRowCount()
		if Tbmrsys.BOMREC_INPUTTYPE(ni) = "H" Then
			hmdSatir = hmdSatir + 1
	'		RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue "REPORT___DELETED", row, "X"
			RaporRowSet.AddRow
			satirNo = RaporRowSet.GetRowCount()
			For nj = 0 to uBound(Fields, 1)
				AlanAdi = Fields(nj,0)
				if AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_KODU" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni)
				Elseif AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_ADI" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni), "")
				Elseif AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_MIKTAR" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(ni)
				Elseif AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_BIRIM" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "IUNIT", Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni), "")
				Else
					if AlanAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" and hmdsatir > 1 Then
						AlanDegeri = 0
					Else
						AlanDegeri = RaporRowSet.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, row)
					End if
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, AlanDegeri
				End if
			Next
		End if
	Next
	if hmdSatir > 0 Then RAPOR.DEL = "X"
End if Dim nRows,T_BOMU01T, Mamuller, ni, MamullerPasif
Mamuller = ""
MamullerPasif = ""
nrows = Doc.SelectEQ("BOMU01T","BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE",RAPOR.KOD)
if Nrows > 0 then
	Set T_BOMU01T = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_BOMU01T_SELECT")
	T_BOMU01T.GroupBy("BOMREC_CODE")
	for ni=1 to T_BOMU01T.GetRecCount
		if trim(T_BOMU01T.AKTIF_PASIF(ni))  = "*" Then
			Mamuller = Mamuller & trim(T_BOMU01T.BOMREC_CODE(ni)) & ", "
		Else
			MamullerPasif = MamullerPasif & trim(T_BOMU01T.BOMREC_CODE(ni)) & ", "
		end if
	Next
	RAPOR.URUNAGACI_BAGLI = "E"
Else
	RAPOR.URUNAGACI_BAGLI = "H"
End If

if len(Mamuller) > 2 then
	Mamuller = Left(Mamuller,len(Mamuller)-2)
end if
if len(MamullerPasif) > 2 then
	MamullerPasif = Left(MamullerPasif,len(MamullerPasif)-2)
end if
RAPOR.NEICIN = Mamuller
RAPOR.NEICINPASIF = MamullerPasif Dim Tbmrsys, ret, ni, nj, satirNo, Fields, satirSayisi, AlanAdi, AlanDegeri, hmdSatir
ret=Doc.Calc_Bom("O","M", RAPOR.KOD,1,RAPOR.SF_MIKTAR,"",RAPOR.FOKOD,"","","","","","")   
Set Tbmrsys =Doc.GetTableObject("_WBMRSYS_SELECT")
Fields = RaporRowSet.GetFields()
hmdSatir = 0
If isarray(Fields) Then
	For ni = 1 to Tbmrsys.GetRowCount()
		if Tbmrsys.BOMREC_INPUTTYPE(ni) = "H" Then
			hmdSatir = hmdSatir + 1
	'		RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue "REPORT___DELETED", row, "X"
			RaporRowSet.AddRow
			satirNo = RaporRowSet.GetRowCount()
			For nj = 0 to uBound(Fields, 1)
				AlanAdi = Fields(nj,0)
				if AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_KODU" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni)
				Elseif AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_ADI" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni), "")
				Elseif AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_MIKTAR" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(ni)
				Elseif AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_BIRIM" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "IUNIT", Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni), "")
				Else
					if AlanAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" and hmdsatir > 1 Then
						AlanDegeri = 0
					Else
						AlanDegeri = RaporRowSet.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, row)
					End if
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, AlanDegeri
				End if
			Next
		End if
	Next
	if hmdSatir > 0 Then RAPOR.DEL = "X"
End if Dim Tbmrsys, ret, ni, nj, satirNo, Fields, satirSayisi, AlanAdi, AlanDegeri, hmdSatir, ToplamSure
ret=Doc.Calc_Bom("O","M", RAPOR.KOD,1,RAPOR.SF_MIKTAR,"",RAPOR.FOKOD,"","","","","","")   
Set Tbmrsys =Doc.GetTableObject("_WBMRSYS_SELECT")
Fields = RaporRowSet.GetFields()
hmdSatir = 0
If isarray(Fields) Then
	For ni = 1 to Tbmrsys.GetRowCount()
		if Tbmrsys.BOMREC_INPUTTYPE(ni) = "I" Then
			hmdSatir = hmdSatir + 1
	'		RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue "REPORT___DELETED", row, "X"
			RaporRowSet.AddRow
			satirNo = RaporRowSet.GetRowCount()
			ToplamSure = Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(ni) + Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK1(ni) + Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK2(ni)
			For nj = 0 to uBound(Fields, 1)
				AlanAdi = Fields(nj,0)
				if AlanAdi = "TEZGAH_KODU" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni)
				Elseif AlanAdi = "TEZGAH_ADI" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Doc.GetDBFieldValue("IMLT00", "AD", Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni), "")
				Elseif AlanAdi = "OPERASYON" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Tbmrsys.BOMREC_OPERASYON(ni)
				Elseif AlanAdi = "OPERASYON_ADI" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Doc.GetDBFieldValue("IMLT01", "AD", Tbmrsys.BOMREC_OPERASYON(ni), "")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Elseif AlanAdi = "OPERATORTURU1" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Tbmrsys.OPERATORTURU1(ni)
				Elseif AlanAdi = "OPERATORSURE1" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, (Tbmrsys.OPERATORSAYISI1(ni) * ToplamSure)
				Elseif AlanAdi = "OPERATORTURU2" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Tbmrsys.OPERATORTURU2(ni)
				Elseif AlanAdi = "OPERATORSURE2" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, (Tbmrsys.OPERATORSAYISI2(ni) * ToplamSure)
				Elseif AlanAdi = "OPERATORTURU3" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Tbmrsys.OPERATORTURU3(ni)
				Elseif AlanAdi = "OPERATORSURE3" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, (Tbmrsys.OPERATORSAYISI3(ni) * ToplamSure)
				Elseif AlanAdi = "SURE" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, ToplamSure
				Else
					if AlanAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" and hmdsatir > 1 Then
						AlanDegeri = 0
					Else
						AlanDegeri = RaporRowSet.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, row)
					End if
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, AlanDegeri
				End if
			Next
		End if
	Next
	if hmdSatir > 0 Then RAPOR.DEL = "X"
End if Sub Run2
	Dim RunPhase
	Dim ReportOutput
	Set ReportOutput=Doc.CreateSObject("ReportOutput")

	Dim KriterGirisTablosu
	Set KriterGirisTablosu=Doc.GetTableObject("KRITERGIRIS")

	Dim SQLCommand
	Dim Rep17SE_B
	Set Rep17SE_B=Doc.GetTableObject("Rep17SE_B")
	SQLCommand=Trim(Rep17SE_B.SQLTEXT)
	Dim RaporRowSet

	If Len(SQLCommand)=0 Then
'SQL komut yok ise boþ ama alanlarý olan rowset yarat
		Set RaporRowSet=CreateReportRowSet()
	Else
'SQL komut variseSQL komutu kullanarak query yapýlmýþ rowset yarat
		Set RaporRowSet=CreateReportRowSet_SQL(SQLCommand)
		If (Not IsObject(RaporRowSet)) OR IsEmpty(RaporRowSet) OR IsNull(RaporRowSet) Then 
			Exit Sub
		End If
	End If

	Dim AlanBilgisi
	Dim Kriterler_IcmaldenOnce
	Dim Kriterler_IcmaldenSonra
	Dim Kriterler_SiralamaveAraToplamdanSonra
	Set Kriterler_IcmaldenOnce=Doc.CreateSObject("Query")
	Set Kriterler_IcmaldenSonra=Doc.CreateSObject("Query")
	Set Kriterler_SiralamaveAraToplamdanSonra=Doc.CreateSObject("Query")

	Dim JoinSet_IcmaldenOnce
	Dim JoinSet_IcmaldenSonra
	Dim JoinSet_SiralamaveAraToplamdanSonra
	Set JoinSet_IcmaldenOnce=Doc.CreateSObject("JoinSet")
	Set JoinSet_IcmaldenSonra=Doc.CreateSObject("JoinSet")
	Set JoinSet_SiralamaveAraToplamdanSonra=Doc.CreateSObject("JoinSet")

	Dim JoinSubQueryInfo

	Dim CodeList
	Set CodeList=Doc.CreateSObject("CodeList")

	RunPhase="S"

'#include <DYN_rep17100_KriterlerUseTable.inc>


'#include <DYN_rep17100_KRITERAddAndCriteria_YARAT.inc>



	If Len(SQLCommand)=0 Then
'Sql Komut yok ise IcmaldenOnce kriterleri ile query baþlat
		Kriterler_IcmaldenOnce.SetSpecFilterOpt 1
		If RaporRowSet.RunQuery(Kriterler_IcmaldenOnce) <> 0 Then Exit Sub
	Else
'Sql Komut var ise sadece IcmaldenOnce kriterleri uygula
		If RaporRowSet.Filter(Kriterler_IcmaldenOnce) <> 0 Then Exit Sub
	End If

	PV_SpecFilterResult_C=Kriterler_IcmaldenOnce.GetSpecFilterResult("C")
	PV_SpecFilterResult_M1=Kriterler_IcmaldenOnce.GetSpecFilterResult("M1")


'#include <DYN_rep17100_RaporRowSetSort.inc>



	Dim TOPLAM(100)

	Dim ROW
	Dim RAPOR
	Set RAPOR=RaporRowSet

'#include <DYN_rep17100_HESAPLAMALARI_YARAT_ICMALDENONCE_JOIN.inc>


	If RaporRowSet.Join(JoinSet_IcmaldenOnce) <> 0 Then Exit Sub


'#include <DYN_rep17100_HESAPLAMALARI_YARAT_ICMALDENONCE.inc>


	If RaporRowSet.Filter(Kriterler_IcmaldenOnce) <> 0 Then Exit Sub

'#include <DYN_rep17100_RaporRowSetGroupBy.inc>


	RunPhase="I"
'#include <DYN_rep17100_HESAPLAMALARI_YARAT_ICMALDENSONRA_JOIN.inc>


	If RaporRowSet.Join(JoinSet_IcmaldenSonra) <> 0 Then Exit Sub
'#include <DYN_rep17100_HESAPLAMALARI_YARAT_ICMALDENSONRA.inc>


	If RaporRowSet.Filter(Kriterler_IcmaldenSonra) <> 0 Then Exit Sub

'#include <DYN_rep17100_RaporRowSetSort.inc>



'#include <DYN_rep17100_RaporRowSetSubTotal.inc>


	If RaporRowSet.GrandTotal() <> 0 Then Exit Sub
	If RaporRowSet.ReNum() <> 0 Then Exit Sub
'#include <DYN_rep17100_RaporRowSetOzetRapor.inc>



'#include <DYN_rep17100_HESAPLAMALARI_YARAT_SIRALAMAVEARATOPLAMDANSONRA_JOIN.inc>


	If RaporRowSet.Join(JoinSet_SiralamaveAraToplamdanSonra) <> 0 Then Exit Sub
	RunPhase="A"
'#include <DYN_rep17100_HESAPLAMALARI_YARAT_SIRALAMAVEARATOPLAMDANSONRA.inc>


	If RaporRowSet.Filter(Kriterler_SiralamaveAraToplamdanSonra) <> 0 Then Exit Sub
	If RaporRowSet.ReNum() <> 0 Then Exit Sub

'#include <DYN_rep17100_ReportOutputAddField_YARAT.inc>



	Call PrintReport(RaporRowSet,ReportOutput)
End Sub

	Set CreateReportRowSet=RaporRowSet

Function CreateReportRowSet_SQL(SQLCommand)
	Dim RaporRowSet
	Set RaporRowSet=Doc.RunSQLQuery("REPORT1",SQLCommand)
	If (Not IsObject(RaporRowSet)) OR IsEmpty(RaporRowSet) OR IsNull(RaporRowSet) Then 
		CreateReportRowSet_SQL=0
		Exit Function
	End If

	Dim AlanBilgisi
	Set AlanBilgisi=Doc.CreateSObject("FieldDefinition")

	RaporRowSet.AddField_PreServe_Begin

'#include <DYN_rep17100_RAPORROWSET_ALANLARINI_YARAT_JOIN_PRESERVE.inc>


'#include <DYN_rep17100_RAPORROWSET_ALANLARINI_YARAT_PRESERVE.inc>



	RaporRowSet.AddField_PreServe_End

	Set CreateReportRowSet_SQL=RaporRowSet
End Function

	RAPOR.TMP_REPORT___AVGDATE_TD_01=Doc.Date_StrToNum(RAPOR.TARIH)*RAPOR.SF_MIKTAR
	RAPOR.ORTALAMA_TARIH_TARIH_1=RAPOR.TARIH
Else
	RAPOR.ORTALAMA_TARIH_TARIH_1=Doc.Date_NumToStr(Doc.Div(RAPOR.TMP_REPORT___AVGDATE_TD_01,RAPOR.SF_MIKTAR))
End If                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     Dim S10A, ni, CikisMiktar, BugunTarih, MiktarTarih, ET, QStr
CikisMiktar = 0
MiktarTarih = 0
QStr = "LOTNUMBER='"+RAPOR.LOTNUMBER+"'&KOD='"+RAPOR.KOD+"'&SF_MIKTAR<0"
Set S10A = Doc.Select1("WWW", "STOK10A",QStr, "", -1)
For ni = 1 to S10A.GetRecCount()
	ET = trim(S10A.EVRAKTYPE(ni))
	if (trim(ET) = "M2" or trim(ET) = "RI" or trim(ET) = "DG" or trim(ET) = "F2") and RAPOR.KOD = S10A.KOD(ni) Then
		CikisMiktar = CikisMiktar + Abs(S10A.SF_MIKTAR(ni))
		MiktarTarih = MiktarTarih + Abs(S10A.SF_MIKTAR(ni)) * Doc.CDateToInt(S10A.TARIH(ni))
	End if
Next
RAPOR.CIKISMIKTARI = CikisMiktar
RAPOR.KALAN = RAPOR.SF_MIKTAR - RAPOR.CIKISMIKTARI
BugunTarih = Doc.CDateToInt(Doc.BuGun)
RAPOR.ORTALAMACIKISTARIHI = Doc.Date_NumToStr(Doc.Div(MiktarTarih + RAPOR.KALAN * BugunTarih, RAPOR.SF_MIKTAR)) SELECT STOK10A.KOD, STOK10A.LOTNUMBER, STOK10A.SERINO, STOK10A.AMBCODE, STOK10A.LOCATION1, STOK10A.LOCATION2, 
STOK10A.LOCATION3, STOK10A.LOCATION4, SUM(STOK10A.SF_MIKTAR) SF_MIKTAR, STOK10A.SF_UNIT, STOK10A.VRI_VR_C, 
STOK10A.VRI_VR_R1, STOK10A.VRI_VR_R2, STOK10A.VRI_VR_R3, STOK10A.VRI_NUM1, STOK10A.VRI_NUM2, STOK10A.FOKOD,
SUM(STOK10A.TL_TUTAR) TL_TUTAR, SUM(STOK10A.TL_NONMIKTARTUTAR) TL_NONMIKTARTUTAR, STOK00.AD AD, STOK00.GK_1 GK_1,
STOK00.GK_2 GK_2, STOK00.GK_3 GK_3,STOK00.GK_4 GK_4, STOK00.GK_5 GK_5,STOK00.GK_6 GK_6,STOK00.GK_7 GK_7,STOK00.GK_8 GK_8,
STOK00.GK_9 GK_9,STOK00.GK_10 GK_10, SUM(STOK10A.TL_TUTAR)+SUM(STOK10A.TL_NONMIKTARTUTAR) MALIYET
FROM STOK10A
INNER JOIN STOK00 ON STOK00.KOD=STOK10A.KOD
WHERE 1=1
 AND STOK10A.KOD>=###KRITERGIRIS.B_KOD###
###IF NOTEMPTY KRITERGIRIS.E_KOD###
And STOK10A.KOD<=###KRITERGIRIS.E_KOD###
###ENDIF###
###IF NOTEMPTY KRITERGIRIS.E_TARIH###

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       Dim S46T, QStr, ni, SipTesTar, GTesTar, Fark, ArtTeslimPuan, ToplamTeslimPuan, Erken1, Gec1, Zamaninda1
QStr="CH_KODU='"+RAPOR.KOD+"'&REV_RTESTARIH>='"+KRITERGIRIS.B_TARIH+"'&REV_RTESTARIH<='"+KRITERGIRIS.E_TARIH+"'"
QStr = QStr & "&ACIKKAPALI='K'&SF_NETKAPANANMIK>0"
Set S46T = Doc.Select1("AA","STOK46T",QStr,"",-1)
RAPOR.ADET2 = S46T.GetRowCount
ToplamTeslimPuan = 0:Erken1=0:Gec1=0:Zamaninda1=0
for ni = 1 to S46T.GetRecCount()
	SipTesTar=S46T.REV_RTESTARIH(ni)
	GTesTar=Doc.STOK46A_AVGTESLIMTARIHI(S46T.ARTNO(ni))
	if trim(GTesTar) = "" Then GTesTar = Doc.BuGun
	Fark = Doc.cDateToInt(SipTesTar) - Doc.cDateToInt(GTesTar)
	if Fark > 0 then
		Erken1=Erken1+1
	Elseif Fark < 0 then
		Gec1=Gec1+1
	Else
		Zamaninda1=Zamaninda1+1
	End if
	if Fark >= -3 and Fark <= 0 then
		ArtTeslimPuan = 20
	ElseIf Fark >= 1 and Fark <= 3 then
		ArtTeslimPuan = 15
	ElseIf Fark >= -6 and Fark <= -4 then
		ArtTeslimPuan = 10
	ElseIf Fark >= 4 and Fark <= 6 then
		ArtTeslimPuan = 5
	Else
		ArtTeslimPuan = 0
	end if
	ToplamTeslimPuan = ToplamTeslimPuan + ArtTeslimPuan
Next
RAPOR.ERKEN = Erken1:RAPOR.GEC = Gec1:RAPOR.ZAMANINDA = Zamaninda1
RAPOR.TOPLAM_TESLIM_PUAN = ToplamTeslimPuan 			hmdSatir = hmdSatir + 1
	'		RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue "REPORT___DELETED", row, "X"

			satirNo = RaporRowSet.GetRowCount()

				if AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_KODU" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni)
				Elseif AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_ADI" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni), "")
				Elseif AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_MIKTAR" Then

					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "IUNIT", Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni), "")
				Else
					'if AlanAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" and hmdsatir > 1 Then
						'AlanDegeri = 0
					'Else
						AlanDegeri = RaporRowSet.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, row)
					'End if

			Next
		End if
	Next
	if hmdSatir > 0 Then RAPOR.DEL = "X"

                                                                                                                                                                                               Dim Set Tbmrsys =Doc.GetTableObject("_WBMRSYS_SELECT")
Fields = RaporRowSet.GetFields()
hmdSatir = 0
If isarray(Fields) Then
	For ni = 1 to Tbmrsys.GetRowCount()
		if Tbmrsys.BOMREC_INPUTTYPE(ni) = "H" Then
			hmdSatir = hmdSatir + 1
	'		RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue "REPORT___DELETED", row, "X"
			RaporRowSet.AddRow
			satirNo = RaporRowSet.GetRowCount()
			For nj = 0 to uBound(Fields, 1)
				AlanAdi = Fields(nj,0)
				if AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_KODU" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni)
				Elseif AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_ADI" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni), "")
				Elseif AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_MIKTAR" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(ni)
				Elseif AlanAdi = "HAMMADDE_BIRIM" Then
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "IUNIT", Tbmrsys.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(ni), "")
				Else
					if AlanAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" and hmdsatir > 1 Then
						AlanDegeri = 0
					Else
						AlanDegeri = RaporRowSet.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, row)
					End if
					RaporRowSet.SetFieldValue AlanAdi, satirNo, AlanDegeri
				End if
			Next
		End if
	Next
	if hmdSatir > 0 Then RAPOR.DEL = "X"
End if Dim nRows,T_BOMU01T, Mamuller, ni, MamullerPasif
Mamuller = ""
MamullerPasif = ""
nrows = Doc.SelectEQ("BOMU01T","BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE",RAPOR.KOD)
if Nrows > 0 then
	Set T_BOMU01T = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_BOMU01T_SELECT")
	T_BOMU01T.GroupBy("BOMREC_CODE")
	for ni=1 to T_BOMU01T.GetRecCount
		if trim(T_BOMU01T.AKTIF_PASIF(ni))  = "*" Then
			Mamuller = Mamuller & trim(T_BOMU01T.BOMREC_CODE(ni)) & ", "
		Else
			MamullerPasif = MamullerPasif & trim(T_BOMU01T.BOMREC_CODE(ni)) & ", "
		end if
	Next
	RAPOR.URUNAGACI_BAGLI = "E"
Else
	RAPOR.URUNAGACI_BAGLI = "H"
End If

if len(Mamuller) > 2 then
	Mamuller = Left(Mamuller,len(Mamuller)-2)
end if
if len(MamullerPasif) > 2 then
	MamullerPasif = Left(MamullerPasif,len(MamullerPasif)-2)
end if
RAPOR.NEICIN = Mamuller
